name: Loop prevention blocks Case creation from org-wide email sender
description: Verifies that when the sender address matches the org-wide email address, no new Case is created (prevents infinite email loops)

emailProperties.subject: Test-10-{{timestamp}} Loop Prevention Test
emailProperties.textBody: This email is sent from the org-wide address and should not create a Case.
emailProperties.htmlBody: This email is sent from the org-wide address and should not create a Case.

queries.filter: Subject = 'Test-10-{{timestamp}} Loop Prevention Test' AND Status = '3'
Subject__c = 'Test-10-{{timestamp}} Loop Prevention Test' AND Sender__c = '{{org_wide_email}}'

assertions.note: May or may not exist depending on whether spam filter captures it or silently discards
